profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its site presents Claude as its AI, described as built for problem solvers and aimed at complex challenges, data analysis, code writing, and difficult work. The company's product set also includes the Anthropic Console, an API management console with prompt testing, evaluation tools, usage monitoring, and cost controls; Claude Code, described as agentic coding with source-code exposure; and Computer Use (Anthropic), a computer control agent for desktop automation and system access that carries high-privilege operation risk.

The litigation record is substantial. Cases are listed in the District Court for the Northern District of California (Patel v. Anthropic, PBC; Smith v. Anthropic, PBC; Pascual v. Anthropic, PBC; Shakespeare v. Anthropic PBC; Kahn v. Anthropic PBC), the District of Delaware (Haugland v. Anthropic PBC and University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC), the District of Hawaii (Gribble v. Anthropic PBC and Haugland v. Anthropic PBC), the District of Vermont (Brunell v. Anthropic PBC), and the Eastern District of Pennsylvania (GROSSINGER v. ANTHROPIC, PBC.). Edelson, PC, et al. v. Anthropic, PBC is listed at the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Litigation exposure is recorded against California, with a count of 281.

An MCP server is also registered under the name ai.getvda/llm-orchestration-agent-langchain-anthropic, described as an LLM Orchestration Agent (Langchain Anthropic).
